lines: Sandeep Sudhakar Asolkar, held jointly with Priya Sandeep Asolkar, is a Promoter Selling Shareholder selling 934,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹30.82 crore are scheduled for on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by listing notice.
Event was 12 days ago, so the proceeds are recent; discuss how they plan to deploy the money once received.
Caveat: average cost of acquisition and pre-offer holding are not confirmed from the documents.
